headline.purpose: Empty-state headings only; the ramp ceiling at 19px.

brand.purpose: The Save Book wordmark in the 46px top bar, once per page.

body.purpose: Page default: prose, inputs, selects, tab labels, switch caption, rail row titles, section headings.

control-sm.purpose: Compact 30px rail buttons and segmented kind-control segments.

label.purpose: Muted field labels above controls; never uppercase.

hint.purpose: Help text under controls and small empty-state prose; 62ch / 48ch caps.

data.purpose: A stored value or host pattern in a text field (mono 12.5px).

data-sm.purpose: The second line of a rail row or site row: pattern, value, dot mask (mono 11px).

count.purpose: Count pills and the n-sites route stamp; tabular figures so widths never shift.

micro.purpose: Flag pill text only (10.5px sans); the smallest size in the product.

card-label.purpose: The card row's left, muted label (11.5px sans).

card-value.purpose: The card row's right-aligned mono value (11.5px).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The only real elevation: the on-page card resting on a host page and the toast resting on settings.

shadows.name: segment
shadows.purpose: Micro-lift of the active segment in the segmented kind control.

shadows.name: knob
shadows.purpose: Micro-lift of the toggle switch knob, which stays white in both schemes.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Focus halo for fields and the switch track. Distinct from the 2px solid accent outline used on buttons and rows.

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Chevron rotation, switch track background and knob translation.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: The single authored keyframe: the toast fading in from a 6px downward offset. Nothing else animates on entry.

breakpoints.name: stacked
breakpoints.purpose: Shell leaves the viewport grid: bar auto-height, one column, rail becomes a 48vh block with a bottom hairline, field grid collapses to one column, and an item row reflows onto three named lines ('kind label label' / 'value value reveal' / 'stamp stamp remove') while keeping one column per field.

layout.bar: flex, align-items: stretch, gap: 20px, padding: 0 16px, background var(--surface), border-bottom 1px var(--line)
layout.rail: flex column, gap: 10px, padding: 14px 12px, background var(--surface), border-right 1px var(--line), overflow auto
layout.panelRhythm: padding 16px 18px, 14px between stacked panels, footer separated by a 1px top hairline with 14px padding-top and 16px margin-top
layout.rowRhythm: 1px gaps inside rail lists and site lists; 6px between editable item rows; 8px between the columns inside an item row; 7px 9px inside a rail or site row. An item row is one line of six grid columns (128px / minmax(0,1fr) / minmax(0,1.15fr) / 28px / 74px / 30px) below 900px and a three-line named-areas template above it.
layout.proseCaps: 62ch section notes, 48ch panel footers, 520px empty-state placeholder, 860px editor
layout.card: fixed 272px wide (min(272px, 100vw - 24px)), 44vh list cap, 12px gutter from viewport edges, moved with translate3d
layout.itemRow: grid-template-columns: 128px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr) 28px 74px 30px; gap: 8px; align-items: center — kind-switch, .item-label, .item-value, .field-actions, .stamp-slot, remove icon-button (28px, justify-self: end). Under 900px: grid-template-columns: 118px minmax(0, 1fr) 28px with areas 'kind label label' / 'value value reveal' / 'stamp stamp remove' and row-gap: 6px; .stamp-slot then justifies flex-start. Slots are always rendered so every field keeps its column.
layout.fieldHeightRule: A control beside a field matches the field: .add .button and .field-row .button are 34px, not the 36px a lone button takes; the compact rail adders are 30px. The editor's .value-wrap is grid minmax(0, 1fr) 28px with a 28px icon button, so the value input's right edge is kind-independent.

states.name: hover
states.treatment: var(--hover) wash; text moves to var(--fg) where the element is muted; primary button brightens with filter: brightness(1.08); danger hover is a 10% danger wash; danger icon button turns var(--danger).

states.name: focus-visible (controls and rows)
states.treatment: outline: 2px solid var(--accent) with offset 1px on buttons/icon buttons, 2px on rail titles, inset -2px on rail rows, -3px on tabs and 1px on kind switches; the card row uses a 1px accent outline inset -1px plus a hover wash.

states.name: focus-visible (fields and switch)
states.treatment: no outline: border-color becomes var(--accent) and box-shadow: var(--ring) (3px accent 18% halo).

states.name: selected
states.treatment: rail: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) wash; tab: var(--fg) text plus a 2px accent underline inset 8px and dropped 1px onto the bar hairline; kind segment: var(--raise) chip with a 1px soft lift.

states.name: off / disabled
states.treatment: disabled site or item names drop to var(--muted) and carry a flag pill (card off / not on any site); disabled buttons are opacity: 0.5 with a default cursor.

states.name: empty
states.treatment: 12.5px muted prose with the actionable phrase in var(--fg) 600 (items-empty, 62ch cap); placeholder is 19px/600 heading over 13px muted prose, 520px wide; the card shows 'No items yet' plus an accent Add items link.

states.name: flag pill
states.treatment: unfilled pill, 1px var(--line-strong), mono subline's sans reset at 10.5px, muted text; payloads are 'card off' and 'not on any site'.

states.name: error
states.treatment: var(--danger) text with a color-mix(danger 40%) border on the toast and color-mix(danger 35%) border on the danger button; danger icon buttons turn red on hover. Errors name the problem and the recovery in the toast's text.

states.name: copied
states.treatment: The card's value cell swaps to the word 'Copied' in var(--accent) for 1000ms, then reverts. The only accent-coloured text outside links and focus.

states.name: revealed / masked
states.treatment: A secret renders as a run of dots; the masked card value is var(--muted) and the eye icon button toggles reveal in place without copying. The reveal button is an icon button inside an always-present .field-actions slot, so its column exists whether or not the item is a secret; its title names the next action ('Reveal the value' / 'Hide the value', 'Reveal' / 'Hide' in the card) and it carries aria-pressed, which is the state channel for the toggle.

states.name: armed destructive confirm
states.treatment: First click arming, second click acting, label becomes 'Click again to delete' / 'Click again to delete everywhere' and reverts after 4000ms.

surfaceOwnership.sharedRule: One token sheet, themed once by prefers-color-scheme. The options page binds the tokens at :root; the on-page card carries the ui-tokens class inside its shadow root so the same values exist in that document fragment.
settingsOwns: item rows and site rows (the mirror)
cardOwns: accent Add items link in its empty state

unusedOrDriftedTokens.note: card.css hardcodes the stack instead of var(--font); identical values, duplicated source.
card.css hardcodes the mono stack and omits 'SF Mono', which var(--mono) includes.
The Items rail's filter is input[type='search'], so the browser's own clear affordance renders unthemed inside a themed field. Drift, not canon.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per rail: the Sites rail's Add, and the item's site assignment. Accent fill, accent-ink label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; color: var(--accent-fg); background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 520 13.5px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Surface-filled neutral button: Apply a new domain, Add a picked site.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; color: var(--fg); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 520 13.5px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Borderless muted action: the + Text / + Password adders (30px compact) and Reset card position.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="13" height="13" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3.5v9M3.5 8h9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg>Text</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--muted); background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 520 12.5px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--fg); background: var(--hover); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive footer action with a two-step arm: first click changes the label, second click acts.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; color: var(--danger); background: none; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 35%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 520 13.5px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Square icon-only control for reveal, remove and card acts; 22px at rest, 28px in an item row and in the editor value field, 26px in a site row, 18px in the card. Always title + aria-label; toggles add aria-pressed.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" title="Remove from this site" aria-label="Remove from this site"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4.5 4.5l7 7M11.5 4.5l-7 7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { --ds-icon-button-size: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 0 0 auto; width: var(--ds-icon-button-size); height: var(--ds-icon-button-size); padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--danger); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Field (data variant included)
components.description: The only field treatment: 34px, surface fill, control-edge border, accent border plus ring on focus. Host patterns and stored values switch to mono.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Optional, shown in the card" aria-label="Item label" /><input class="ds-input ds-input-mono" type="text" value="qa@northwind.test" aria-label="Item value" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--fg); background: var(--field); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 400 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--ring); } .ds-input-mono { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The only container: surface fill, 1px hairline, 12px radius, no shadow, with a hairline-separated footer for the panel's actions.
components.html:
Items on this site

Items are shared: a value edited here changes on every site it is shown on.

One item, 3 sites.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px 18px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); } .ds-panel + .ds-panel { margin-top: 14px; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel-hint { margin: -4px 0 12px; max-width: 62ch; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-panel-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-hint { max-width: 48ch; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Rail Row (index row)
components.description: The whole row is one button. Name on line one, mono data plus an optional flag pill on line two, count pill in the last column; selected rows take a 12% accent wash.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-rail-open { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 1px 8px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 7px 9px; color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-open:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-on .ds-rail-open { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); } .ds-rail-open:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-rail-title { grid-column: 1; overflow: hidden; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; text-align: left; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-rail-sub { display: flex; grid-column: 1 / -1; gap: 6px; align-items: center; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; } .ds-rail-sub-text { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-count { grid-column: 2; min-width: 20px; padding: 2px 6px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--hover); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font: 500 11px/1.45 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; } .ds-flag { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 1px 6px; color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Sites / Items tabs living on the top bar's own hairline; selection is muted-to-ink text plus a 2px accent underline dropped onto the hairline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 2px; height: 100%; } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 100%; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--muted); background: none; border: 0; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 520; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--fg); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--fg); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 8px -1px 8px; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 1px; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); } .ds-count { min-width: 18px; padding: 1px 5px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--hover); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font: 500 11px/1.45 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; }

components.name: Segmented Kind Switch
components.description: Text / Password, the same control wherever an item's kind appears: a wash track with a raised active chip. Both options always visible, each button aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-kind { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; background: var(--hover); border-radius: var(--radius-md); } .ds-kind button { padding: 3px 9px; color: var(--muted); background: none; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 520 11.5px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-kind button:hover { color: var(--fg); } .ds-kind button.ds-on { color: var(--fg); background: var(--raise); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.1); } .ds-kind button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: The per-site card on/off. Real checkbox kept in the DOM and visually hidden; the track carries the state and the focus ring.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-top: 12px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-track { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 34px; height: 20px; background: var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); transition: background 0.16s ease; } .ds-knob { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #fff; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); transition: transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-track { background: var(--accent); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-track .ds-knob { transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-track { box-shadow: var(--ring); } .ds-switch-label { font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient confirmation and error, centred at the bottom of the viewport, announced through a live region and dismissed after 4200ms. The product's only animation.
components.html:
QA login now shows on Staging (QA).
Chrome access to staging.northwind.test was not granted
components.css: .ds-toast { position: fixed; bottom: 20px; left: 50%; max-width: 520px; padding: 9px 15px; transform: translateX(-50%); color: var(--fg); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); box-shadow: var(--shadow-float); font-size: 12.5px; text-align: center; animation: ds-toast-in 0.18s ease-out; } .ds-toast.ds-err { color: var(--danger); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 40%, transparent); } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, 6px); } }

components.name: On-Page Card
components.description: The pinned craft reference: a 272px translucent panel in a shadow root, drag-only header, hairline separator, label-left / mono-value-right rows that copy on click.
components.html:
Staging (QA)
  • QA loginqa@northwind.test
components.css: .ds-card { width: min(272px, calc(100vw - 24px)); color: var(--fg); background: var(--surface-float); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-float); font: 400 13px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; user-select: none; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 7px 7px 9px; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; } .ds-card-head:active { cursor: grabbing; } .ds-grip { display: flex; color: var(--muted); opacity: 0.45; } .ds-card-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-sep { height: 1px; background: var(--line); } .ds-card-items { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 5px 6px 7px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; max-height: 44vh; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 7px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-row:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-card-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -1px; background: var(--hover); } .ds-lbl { flex: 0 1 auto; max-width: 46%; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-val { flex: 1; min-width: 0; text-align: right; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Item Row (fixed slots)
components.description: One row of a site's items. Six grid columns, two of them always-present slots, so the same field lands in the same place and at the same width in every row; reflows to three named lines under 900px.
components.html: • 3 sites
components.css: .ds-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 128px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr) 28px 74px 30px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; list-style: none; } .ds-item .ds-icon-btn { --ds-icon-button-size: 28px; } .ds-item > .ds-remove { justify-self: end; } .ds-field-actions, .ds-stamp-slot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-item > .ds-stamp-slot { min-width: 0; } .ds-item-label, .ds-item-value { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--fg); background: var(--field); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 400 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-item-value { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-item-label:focus-visible, .ds-item-value:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--ring); } .ds-stamp { padding: 1px 6px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--hover); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font: 500 11px/1.55 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-item { grid-template-columns: 118px minmax(0, 1fr) 28px; grid-template-areas: 'kind label label' 'value value reveal' 'stamp stamp remove'; row-gap: 6px; } .ds-item > .ds-kind { grid-area: kind; } .ds-item > .ds-item-label { grid-area: label; } .ds-item > .ds-item-value { grid-area: value; } .ds-item > .ds-field-actions { grid-area: reveal; } .ds-item > .ds-stamp-slot { grid-area: stamp; justify-content: flex-start; } .ds-item > .ds-remove { grid-area: remove; } }

narrative.overview:
Save Book is one record seen from both ends, and it is drawn like an instrument that is already mid-task: hairline rules instead of boxes, one accent that means state and nothing else, and data set in monospace so a host pattern, a stored value and a count all read as readings rather than sentences. Nothing here is decorated. Density is deliberate — a 1px rhythm between index rows, a 292px rail, a 46px bar — because the user's job is to scan their own store and act on it, not to admire a page.

The world was set by the on-page card and is held exactly: the same neutral ground, the same 10% ink hairline, the same #4f46e5 in light and #a5b4fc in dark, the same label-left/value-right anatomy, the same quiet hover. Settings extends that vocabulary rather than restating it, which is why a full-tab options page and a 272px page-injected panel can sit side by side and read as one tool. The card is the user's pinned craft reference; when this document and the card disagree, the card wins.

The type is the system stack at small sizes and never grows up: the largest text in the product is a 19px empty-state heading. Hierarchy is carried by weight, colour and family (sans for structure, mono for data) rather than by size. Depth is carried by a ground change and a hairline — the rail is the raised surface, the editor is the canvas — and exactly one soft float shadow exists for the two things that genuinely float. The single authored moment is the toast arriving.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, reserved for state: selection, focus, the selected tab's underline, copied values, links, and the single primary button per screen.
Hairlines at 10% ink (--line) do the separating; --line-strong is reserved for the edge of an interactive control.
Sans sets structure, monospace sets data — values, host patterns, counts, stamps.
Depth is a ground change, not a stack of shadows; one --shadow-float for card and toast.
Everything that is one object looks like one object: a rail row is a single button; a site row in an item's panel reuses the rail's own title class.
Density with air at the edges: 1px gaps inside lists, 14–16px between panels, 22px page padding.

rules.name: The Reserved Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent never fills a large area. Its widest uses are the primary button and the 12% selected-row wash; if a new screen needs a coloured block, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Division is 1px of --line at 10% ink. Use --line-strong only where an element is a control the user clicks or types into. Never a 2px divider, never a grey box.

rules.name: The Ground Change Rule
rules.body: Rail is --surface, editor is --bg. The two grounds plus their shared hairline are the layout; do not add a third ground to identify a region.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is applied when the string is a reading — a stored value, a host pattern, a count, a stamp. Monospace is never applied to a name, a label, a button, a tab, or a heading. When a mono line needs a sans word inside it (the flag pill), the pill resets its own family.

rules.name: The Ramp Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Nothing exceeds 19px. A screen that needs a bigger number is a screen that needs less content.

rules.name: The Fixed Slot Rule
rules.body: A field's position and width are its own grid column, never a consequence of what its row happens to contain. The reveal slot and the stamp slot are rendered in every item row whether or not there is an eye or a pill to put in them, and the editor's value field keeps the same 28px for its reveal button whether the item is text or secret. The same field therefore lands on the same x and the same width in every row of a list — measured identical at 1440, 1280 and 1024, and identical per column at 390.

rules.name: The One Float Rule
rules.body: Only the card and the toast get --shadow-float. A panel, a rail row, a menu or a dialog answered from this vocabulary gets a hairline and a ground, never a shadow.

dos: Do use --accent only for state: focus rings, the selected rail row's 12% wash, the selected tab's 2px underline, the copied value, links, and one primary button per rail.
Do separate with a 1px --line hairline or a ground change; reach for --line-strong only on the edge of something interactive.
Do set every value, host pattern, count and stamp in var(--mono), and give counters font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so widths never shift.
Do keep the 1px rhythm inside index lists and give editable rows 6px, panels 14px, and the field grid 16px.
Do reuse the rail's classes (rail-title, rail-sub, count, flag) when a new view shows the same record from another end — the mirror in this product is literal in code, not a lookalike.

Do give every field its own column and render its slot even when it is empty — the reveal and stamp slots in an item row, and the editor's 28px value slot — so a field never moves or resizes because of what a neighbouring row contains.
Do cap prose at 62ch (sections) and 48ch (panel footers), and cap editor content at 860px.
Do keep body text at 13px, labels at 11.5px/550, and never exceed 19px.
Do give destructive controls the red token plus the two-step arm (the label becomes "Click again to delete", reverting after 4s) and put them alone in the panel footer's right slot.
donts: Don't add a shadow to a panel, a row, or a menu: --shadow-float belongs to the on-page card and the toast, and the segments/knob micro-lifts are the only other permitted drops.
Don't introduce a third ground; the rail is --surface and the editor is --bg.
Don't fill anything large with the accent, and don't tint a neutral with it to "add warmth".
Don't put mono on a name, label, tab, heading or button — and don't put sans on a value, pattern, count or stamp.
Don't use a glyph, emoji or icon font where an authored SVG icon belongs, and never let an icon carry meaning alone.
Don't raise font weight or size to create hierarchy where --muted vs --fg already does.
Don't restyle the browser's own affordances beyond what the build already themes (selection tint, accent caret, themed scrollbars); the rest of the chrome is the platform's.
